sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/riverview-campground ('There are 24 camp units, which are large enough for 30-foot trailer lengths'; last updated August 31, 2026) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10169617 (same), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Three vault toilets and five water spigots (recreation.gov lists drinking water in peak season). Campground host. Cell reception.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/riverview-campground ('There are three vault toilets and water is available'; 'Potable water is available at this site.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10169617 ('three outhouses and five water spigots'; amenities 'Drinking Water (peak season)', 'Host', 'Cell Phone Service'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'Open annually, late May through mid-October, weather dependent.'

First come, first served; pay at the self-pay station (cash or check, exact amount) or with recreation.gov Scan & Pay. Sites must be attended the first night and not left unattended more than 24 hours.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/riverview-campground ('First come-first served.', '16 day stay limit.', 'Cash or check only. There is no change available') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10169617 ('This is a First Come - First Served campground so reservations are not accepted'; rules maxConsecutiveStay 16, reservationCutOff 'Not Reservable', scanAndPay 1; notice on attended sites), read 2026-10-22

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/riverview-campground ('Single Site: $15 per night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10169617/rates (First-come, First-served Season 2026-05-01 to 2026-09-30: $15), read 2026-10-22

note: Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF (Madison RD) campground at ~6,000 ft on an open sagebrush bench overlooking the Madison River (~1/4 mi east) and the Madison Range, about 34 miles south of Ennis on Hwy 287 near Cameron. The Forest Service calls it 'RV friendly'. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page (updated Aug 31, 2026) and recreation.gov: confirmed 24 sites for 30-ft trailers, vault toilets, water, FCFS, $15; added 16-day limit, Scan & Pay/cash-or-check, attended-site rule, season (late May - mid-October). Alerts: only food-storage and pallet orders. Note trimmed of restated values.
